newsitem.title: USA: Avery Dennison splits stock, hikes payout.
newsitem.headline: Avery Dennison splits stock, hikes payout.

text.p: Avery Dennison Corp Thursday said its board of directors authorized a two-for-one split of the company's common stock and voted to increase the quarterly cash dividend by 13.3 percent.
The stock split will be effected by a distribution on December 20 of one additional share for each share owned by shareholders of record at the close of business on December 6.

The board also approved an increase in the quarterly cash dividend to $0.17 per share from the previous $0.15 per share on the post-split shares, payable on Dec. 20, 1996, to shareholders of record at the close of business on Dec. 6, 1996.

In addition, the company announced the establishment of an employee stock benefit trust to satisfy future obligations under existing benefit plans, including stock plan, 401(k) savings plan, and other employee benefit plans as designated by the company.
The company transferred 9 million shares, previously held as treasury shares, to the trust.
